transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

They brought me in. I guess... well, there was a fuss at the fair. 

I was giving my talk and I climbed up on the tractor. I was just trying to show the crowd the... the new pattern. I kept jerking the controls to show them how it worked. People started yelling at me to get down, but I... I just couldn't make myself stop. 

So, they brought me here.
Have you ever had an episode like this before?
No. Can't say I have. I usually just... mind my own work out on the farm. Never had a fuss like that before.
Have you ever had a period like this before, even if it was milder?
I... no. Like I just said, I haven't. Just out on the farm, mostly. Not sure what else you're looking for.
During this time, have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t?

I... guess so. I don't really talk about it much. 

But... out by the north pasture, especially around dusk... I hear voices. Clear ones. Coming right out of the irrigation lines. They... they tell me which rows are poisoned, and which ones are blessed. 

And it's not just lately. It still happens on weeks when I'm not... all fired up like I was at the fair. Just happens.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt very down or lost interest in things?
No. I don't... I don't really get like that. Always got work to do out there, so... no.
During this current time, have you been feeling depressed or down most of the day?
I just said no. I don't get down like that. Just... regular days. Nothing like that.
During this current time, have you been sleeping much less than usual?

Suppose so. Don't really need much right now. I just... maybe get two, three hours in my chair. Sometimes not at all. Doesn't matter, though. I'm up before the sun anyway, feeling... charged, I guess. Ready to work the place like nothing happened.
Have you ever had a time lasting at least two weeks when you felt very down or lost interest in things?
Thought you just asked me that. Like I said... no. I don't.
Have the voices or other unusual beliefs ever happened when you were not feeling unusually energized or ‘charged’?

Guess so. There were... maybe a few quieter weeks a while back. Wasn't feeling all fired up or anything. But... the lines were still talking. And the farm data... I still knew it had those hidden warnings in it. So... yeah. Still there.
Have you ever had a time when your mood and energy got so high that you needed hospitalization or people had to stop you from doing things because you were out of control?
No. Never needed a hospital for that. People mind their own business out where I am. I handle my own affairs.
Have there been times when the voices or beliefs continued even when your mood and energy were completely back to normal?

I... thought I just told you that. Yeah. Like I said before, there were those quieter weeks. Wasn't feeling all worked up or anything. Just normal. But I still heard the lines talking. And the farm data... I still knew about the hidden warnings in it. So, yes.
Have the voices or false beliefs ever continued for at least two weeks when you were not having any mood symptoms at all?

Yeah. Like I said... it was a few weeks. Maybe several weeks. I wasn't feeling all charged up or... anything. Just regular. But the lines... they were still talking. And the warnings in the data were still there. So... yes. Two weeks, at least.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you had these voices or beliefs but did not have any manic symptoms at the same time?

I feel like we're going in circles here, Doc. Yes. Like I just said... there were several quieter weeks. I wasn't especially energized or... grand, or whatever you want to call it. But I still heard the lines talking. And I still knew the farm data had those hidden warnings in it. I don't know how else to say it.
